verses.text: Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other.
verses.title: A Marriage Observed

verses.text: He who did not spare his own Son, but gave him up for us all—how will he not also, along with him, graciously give us all things?
The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth.
